name: Verify K2 Inbound Signature
queryReplacement: ={{ [$("Extract K2 Signature Context").first().json.clinic_id, $("Extract K2 Signature Context").first().json.channel_id, $("Extract K2 Signature Context").first().json.channel_type, $("Extract K2 Signature Context").first().json.k2_signed_payload, $("Extract K2 Signature Context").first().json.k2_signature, $("Extract K2 Signature Context").first().json.deferred_replay === true] }}
notes: Checks channel-to-clinic binding and HMAC signature; accepts legacy only for channels without a configured signing secret.
